'''Cheyl''' was a [[Selonian/Legends|Selonian]] [[Naturalist/Legends|naturalist]] residing on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] around [[3626 BBY]]. Cheyl attempted to defend Rishi's ecosystem by protecting the few remaining [[Orobird/Legends|orobirds]] from food tourists.
